{{Top|canon=Identification Friend or Foe transponder}}
An '''Identify Friend/Foe transponder''', also known as an '''identification-friend-or-foe transponder''' or '''IFF transponder''', was a military-specific type of transponder signal that would broadcast the ship's affiliation in addition to the standard data. Some automated ships used IFF broadcast streams to dictate their actions. In the prelude to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rebels aboard the stolen Imperial shuttle ''[[Tydirium/Legends|Tydirium]]'' used an IFF transponder to transmit the clearance code that allowed them to land on [[Endor/Legends|the Forest Moon]].<ref name="Pattern and Web">{{RJRadio|Pattern and Web}}</ref> The automated war cruiser [[Valiant (Thranta-class War Cruiser)|''Valiant'']] defended [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] pilot [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] when he recalibrated his IFF transponder to broadcast the same beacon used by the ''[[Another Chance]]''.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> IFF transponders could also be used to trick enemies into firing on each other by using an [[IFF Confuser|IFF transponder scramble]] command.
